titulo: Woman dead and multiple people injured after bus collides with two cars in Victoria
cuerpo: Four occupants of bus taken to hospital after multi-vehicle crash in Glenburn Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A woman has died and several other have been injured after a multi-vehicle collision in Victoria’s Yarra Ranges involving a bus carrying 18 people. Emergency services responded to reports of a three-vehicle crash, including a commercial bus, on the Melba Highway at Glenburn at about 2.40pm. Continue reading...
